description: What the Companies House register shows about a company's health. Status, strike-off proposals, insolvency cases, overdue filings, recent charges and directors leaving — each graded serious / watch / info with a date, plus a one-line summary. A name resolves to one company first. 1 credit. Use this for a quick health check; for the filed figures use accounts, for a fuller picture public_record.

company.description: A UK company number (8 characters, such as 00502851 or SC123456) is surest; a name also works and goes to the closest registered company, which the reply names. Use company_search first when a name could mean several companies.
